A woodfired pizza Restaurant that actually is woodfired!
Jan 2026 • Friends
You know how we keep going to places that say they are wood fired pizzas , but in fact operate on a gas oven? This one really has a wood burning Neapolitan oven, and the results speak for themselves. Lovely garden setting at the back of the restaurant is the best place to sit. The hospitality is great. My pizza took a little longer than expected to be made, and I was shouted to a nice belgian beer!
